Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Eindhoven As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Eindhoven, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders safely and on time. At the beginning of your shift, you prepare for your assigned route. You check what you need for the day, get into the delivery van and use navigation to drive to your first customer. At each address, you select the correct order from the van and carry the grocery crates to the customer's front door. You provide friendly service and make sure the groceries are handed over carefully. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once everything is taken care of, you continue to the next customer. Your working day is a combination of driving, physical activity and customer contact. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and lift grocery crates. At the same time, you have plenty of independence while completing your route through Eindhoven and the surrounding area. After your final delivery, you return to the location, complete your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous experience as a delivery driver? Driving is only one part of your working day. You will regularly lift and carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your route.
